files.main.py:
"""

If the dial is turned two clicks clockwise or counter clockwise, the motor will turn at 75% speed and the YELLOW LED turns on.

"""
"""

If the dial is turned three clicks clockwise or counter clockwise, the motor will turn at 100% speed and the GREEN LED turns on.

"""
"""

If the dial is turned one click clockwise or counter clockwise, the motor will turn at 50% speed and the RED LED turns on.

"""
fwdMotors.con_set_enabled(fwdBase.middle_servo, False)
fwdLights.RED.set_on_off(fwdEnums.OnOff.OFF)
fwdLights.YELLOW.set_on_off(fwdEnums.OnOff.OFF)
fwdLights.GREEN.set_on_off(fwdEnums.OnOff.OFF)

def on_forever():
    if fwdButtons.dial1.position() == 1 or fwdButtons.dial1.position() == -1:
        fwdMotors.set_speed(fwdBase.middle_servo, -50)
        fwdLights.RED.set_on_off(fwdEnums.OnOff.ON)
        fwdLights.YELLOW.set_on_off(fwdEnums.OnOff.OFF)
        fwdLights.GREEN.set_on_off(fwdEnums.OnOff.OFF)
    elif fwdButtons.dial1.position() == 2 or fwdButtons.dial1.position() == -2:
        fwdMotors.set_speed(fwdBase.middle_servo, -75)
        fwdLights.RED.set_on_off(fwdEnums.OnOff.OFF)
        fwdLights.YELLOW.set_on_off(fwdEnums.OnOff.ON)
        fwdLights.GREEN.set_on_off(fwdEnums.OnOff.OFF)
    elif fwdButtons.dial1.position() == 3 or fwdButtons.dial1.position() == -3:
        fwdMotors.set_speed(fwdBase.middle_servo, -100)
        fwdLights.RED.set_on_off(fwdEnums.OnOff.OFF)
        fwdLights.YELLOW.set_on_off(fwdEnums.OnOff.OFF)
        fwdLights.GREEN.set_on_off(fwdEnums.OnOff.ON)
    else:
        fwdMotors.set_speed(fwdBase.middle_servo, 0)
        fwdLights.RED.set_on_off(fwdEnums.OnOff.OFF)
        fwdLights.YELLOW.set_on_off(fwdEnums.OnOff.OFF)
        fwdLights.GREEN.set_on_off(fwdEnums.OnOff.OFF)
basic.forever(on_forever)
